note: 调真实路由抓 SQL 后逐条内联参数打生产；鉴权行也算在内（线上真实请求同样要付）。验收线：详情 ≤500 行

statements.label: 鉴权：会话行
statements.sql: SELECT sub, claims FROM oidc_session WHERE token_hash = '92e2a3caaa3bec34d48004c7da4036f21c00828f51788c7650b9ee4ba5ef63d5' AND revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at > '2026-09-22T13:57:28.473Z'

statements.label: 球队单行
statements.sql: SELECT id, name, is_cpu, league_tier FROM clubs WHERE id = 1 AND status = 'active'

statements.label: 可见赛季
statements.sql: SELECT season FROM seasons WHERE status IN ('preparing', 'running') ORDER BY CASE status WHEN 'running' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, season DESC LIMIT 1

statements.label: 已闭合常规窗口数（刻度）
statements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM season_windows WHERE status = 'closed' AND is_temporary = 0

statements.label: 阵容结构（单队全部行）
statements.sql: SELECT p.id, p.position, p.age, p.ca, p.pa, p.status, p.market_value, p.badges_silver, p.badges_gold, ct.id AS contract_id, ct.wage, ct.protection_ticks, ct.service_ticks FROM players p LEFT JOIN contracts ct ON ct.player_id = p.id AND ct.is_active = 1 WHERE p.club_id = 1

statements.label: 当季定级赛事清单
statements.sql: SELECT tournament_id AS tid, competition_type AS ct FROM season_tournaments WHERE season = 9 AND competition_type IN ('league_premier', 'league_second')

statements.label: 转会往来（转入/转出各一条）
statements.sql: SELECT t.id, t.type, t.player_id, p.name AS player_name, t.from_club_id, fc.name AS from_club_name, t.to_club_id, tc.name AS to_club_name, t.fee, t.extra_fee, t.season, t.window_seq, t.completed_at FROM transfers t LEFT JOIN clubs fc ON fc.id = t.from_club_id LEFT JOIN clubs tc ON tc.id = t.to_club_id LEFT JOIN players p ON p.id = t.player_id WHERE t.to_club_id = 1 AND t.status = 'completed' ORDER BY (t.completed_at IS NULL), t.completed_at DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT 10

statements.label: 近期战绩
statements.sql: SELECT match_id, season, competition_type, stage_name, round, home_team_id, away_team_id, home_team, away_team, score_home, score_away, pen_home, pen_away, walkover_side, finished_at FROM result_confirmations WHERE home_team_id = 73 OR away_team_id = 73 ORDER BY (finished_at IS NULL), finished_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 5
